name: CreateDBInstancePlan

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the plan. Valid values:

PauseResume: automatic start and stop.
Resize: instance upgrade/downgrade, which increases or decreases the number of compute nodes.
ModifySpec: specification change, which changes the node specifications.
InPlaceModifySpec: in-place elastic scaling, which scales the compute resources on the local node without changing the base specifications.

Instance upgrade/downgrade is supported only for instances in Serverless mode.
Specification changes are supported only for instances in elastic storage mode.
In-place elastic scaling is supported only for high availability (HA) instances in elastic storage mode
parameters.help_zh:
计划类型，取值如下：

PauseResume：自动启停。
Resize：实例变配，即增加或减少计算节点。
ModifySpec：规格变更，即变更计算节点规格。
InPlaceModifySpec：本地热弹，即不改变基础规格，本地弹升计算资源。

实例变配仅支持Serverless模式实例。
规格变更仅支持存储弹性模式实例。
本地热弹仅支持存弹高可用实例
parameters.name: plan_type

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the plan. Valid values:

Postpone: execute later.
Regular: periodic execution
parameters.help_zh:
计划执行方式，取值如下：

Postpone：稍后执行。
Regular：周期执行
parameters.name: plan_schedule_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the plan. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. This parameter is required only when PlanScheduleType is set to Regular. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 计划的开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 仅PlanScheduleType为Regular时需要设置该参数。 不传默认为当前时间
parameters.name: plan_start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the plan. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. This parameter is required only when PlanScheduleType is set to Regular. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify an end time, the plan stops when the cycle ends
parameters.help_zh: 计划的结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 仅PlanScheduleType为Regular时需要设置该参数。 该参数非必填，没有结束时间，计划删除周期停止
parameters.name: plan_end_date

parameters.help_en: The detailed information about the execution plan. The value must be in JSON format. The content must be adjusted based on the values of the PlanType and PlanScheduleType parameters. For more information, see the following supplementary instructions
parameters.help_zh: 执行计划具体信息，JSON格式，内容需根据PlanType参数和PlanScheduleType参数的值进行调整，具体说明请参见以下补充说明
parameters.name: plan_config

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message.

This parameter is returned only when the API operation fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。

只会在API执行失败时返回该参数

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the API operation.

If the execution is successful, success is returned. If the execution fails, this parameter is not returned
Status.description_zh:
API执行状态。

执行成功则返回success；执行失败则不返回该参数
